contract: Open the sole-program TS188 or M2TS192 entity through AnyReader. Exercise reset and Blocking::seek, which routes the request through AnyReader::request_seek.

Compare the requested, landing and discard times and every selected picture packet through EOF with the unchanged MPEG-TS picture seek reference. Fold source presentation time, effective decode time, neutral random access and payload. Repeated cases seek again after EOF.

The transport report covers the sole-program single-entity cases. Explicit transport epochs and split entities require format-specific APIs. Matroska and ISO BMFF compare the facade's receipt and every delivered packet with the reference's own backward seek to the requested time: the Matroska worker's native seek, and for ISO BMFF av_seek_frame with AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD at the requested ticks on the requested track. Each packet compares stream, track, PTS, DTS, duration (a reference duration of 0 is unknown), key flag and payload. The facade's extra Matroska preroll packets are verified against a sequential reference pass and the Block timing oracle and counted as a difference. container-pins.json pins the reference output of every case and, for each listed case, the candidate output and the differences its entry declares.
